cam: heads-up — hit a nasty combo when validating the JS SDK across Node, Next Edge, and Cloudflare Workers. Local tests pass but the edge example fails with `TypeError: sdk.default is not a constructor` after bundling.

ryan: that usually means ESM/CJS interop mismatch. are you shipping a default export in ESM bundle?

cam: our rollup output exports named funcs only; CJS build injects `module.exports.default = ...` for compatibility. edge bundle expects default.

maya: two angles: 1) fix build to export both default and named (or provide a namespace), 2) add a worker-specific subpath in package.json so edge consumers import a known ESM-only file.

li: for the latter, use conditional exports: "./worker": { "import": "./dist/esm/worker.js", "types": "./dist/types/worker.d.ts" }. that makes intent explicit for bundlers targeting worker/edge conditions.

cam: ok. another quirk: our retry logic behaves differently in the edge sample — second attempt loses the body (readable stream drained). Node clones work but workers don't.

ryan: yeah workers/readable streams can't always be cloned. pattern: buffer the body (ArrayBuffer) or accept a factory `() => RequestInit` so each attempt gets a fresh body.

maya: add a tiny helper in SDK: `normalizeBodyForRetry(init) -> { body, buffered: boolean }` and document it. for zero-cost in Node path, use `instanceof ReadableStream` checks and only buffer when needed.

li: don't forget to add `types` keys to the `./worker` export. TS resolution often falls back incorrectly if types not present for subpath. consider `typesVersions` mapping too for older TS.

cam: plan: 1) change rollup to emit `export default createClient` in ESM; 2) add `./worker` conditional export + dedicated build that ensures default export and small fetch-cloning shim; 3) add `examples/edge-worker` with CI smoke on Vercel/CF; 4) document SDK import guidance per runtime.

devx-bot: created task DEVX-901: "sdk: worker export + retry-safe bodies + example" assigned to @cam.

ryan: one more tip — for Jest in CI, ensure CJS artifacts are published under dist/cjs and add a `jest` field in package.json or CI step that transpiles ESM. keeps tests stable.

cam: thanks all. I'll open a PR with the worker entry, build tweak, and a minimal example. will link the deploy preview for verification.
